builds.name: ci-release-size
builds.idle_command: human mcp (isolated HOME + HU_STATE_DIR + cwd, no config, stdin held open)
builds.role: Build behind every '~NNNN KB' doc claim: identical flags to the release-size job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which gates those claims with scripts/check-metrics-drift.sh --binary (15%).

builds.name: release-preset
builds.idle_command: human mcp (isolated HOME + HU_STATE_DIR + cwd, no config, stdin held open)
builds.role: What `cmake --preset release` produces for users (sqlite-vec, ML, embedded model, cartesia, cron, feeds, update ON). Same binary_bytes as website/src/content/home/footprint.json at cf52ca7c8 on website-2a-shell-homepage.

startup_variance.note: --version wall time is load-sensitive; quote a range, not a point. Host load average was 42-77 during these runs (concurrent sessions).
